cycles.method: verify_bounds.py: 725 conservative modeled cycles/sample including two split calls, used as a conservative instruction-count ceiling; benchmark.py: 524.5 observed net executed instructions/sample, both cores, expensive settings/modulation and splits 0/1/8/15. These units and chip stalls remain distinct; see TESTING.md.

stock.justification: Full original long stereo sweep, alternating 48-bit air states and precise cascaded sample smoothing. Temporary valid-history masks cost extra for the first 8192 frames, then the original tap fast path is used. Eight-instance initialization plus worst split model consumes 46740 of the 49920-cycle module budget per core/block, before memory stalls and companions; maximum physical headroom is not established.

scope: 31-second native DSP-only replay of three tempo-derived LFO target streams per instance (120 BPM; 1/2/4-beat periods), rapid endpoint locks and 12 parameter-byte targets each step. Only SPD/RNG/MIX have an audible path; other slots are inactive. Both cores, four independent rings each, 0.98-FS bursts plus tones, dirty state and local/shared canaries. ColdFire sequencer/LFO, scenes, MIDI, transport, project and physical timing are not tested.
